 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Oklahoma City Thunder will host the Washington Wizards on Saturday. This will be the first matchup between the two squads in the 2026-27 regular season. This is also the second night of a road-and-home back-to-back for the former.
 The Thunder (7-2) absolutely humiliated the Memphis Grizzlies in a 128-97 win on Friday. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was on cruise control with 28 points in three quarters. Ajay Mitchell had a career-best 35 points and five assists.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Meanwhile, the Wizards (4-5) fell short in a 139-132 loss to the Atlanta Hawks on Friday. Kyshawn George went off for 33 points and seven assists. Trae Young also had 23 points and 10 assists.

 Wizards vs. Thunder injury updates
 Thunder: Jalen Williams (ankle surgery) is out. Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery) is out. Chet Holmgren (knee injury recovery) is out. Jaylin Williams (back spasms) is out. Nikola Topic (G League assignment) is out. Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) is out.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Wizards: Anthony Davis (ankle sprain) is questionable. Justin Champagnie (foot surgery) is out. Tristan Vukcevic (hip impingement) is out. Jamir Watkins (torn ACL) is out. Reece Beekman (AC joint injury) is out. Felix Okpara (G League two-way) is out.
